I went because it said they were open on public holidays in the morning.

It was an emergency, so I went to this clinic, which was nearby and had good reviews, instead of my regular doctor.

When I got there, it was closed.

I left a message saying I was out. They answered that they might call back in 15 minutes.

However, they never called.

Since it's nearby, I'd like to visit again if something happens, so thank you in advance.

The doctors and nurses were very professional and kind to the animals.

The location was easy to find, and since I had written my appointment slip in advance, the whole process was quick.

Thank you so much!

Dear Shoops101

Thank you for your high rating. We will continue to strive to provide you with even greater peace of mind.

Yoyogi-Uehara Animal Hospital, Director Honda

As a foreigner, I'm not very good at Japanese. Even so, the doctor and staff always explained things carefully in the clearest Japanese possible so that I could understand. They answered each of my questions thoughtfully, and I felt very at ease during the examination.

My dog's treatment was also very quick, and thanks to their gentle care, he has recovered completely. I came to the clinic feeling anxious, but thanks to the doctor and staff, I was able to relax, and I am truly grateful.

I'm so glad I met such a wonderful doctor and staff. If anything happens to my dog ​​in the future, I would definitely like to ask for their help. Thank you so much!

Dear Lucas Tse,

Thank you for your kind review. All of our staff will continue to strive to provide you with even greater peace of mind.

Yoyogi-Uehara Animal Hospital, Director Honda

I used to go to another veterinary hospital, but this time I visited here for the first time during their closed hours and they were very considerate and helpful, so I have since made this my regular doctor.
They always explain things carefully and are a trustworthy doctor and hospital.

Mr. Kaihi Ito

Thank you for your high rating. Your evaluation will motivate us to work even harder.

Yoyogi Uehara Animal Hospital Director Honda

Dear S.H.

Thank you for your high rating. It is very encouraging. All of our staff will continue to work hard.

Yoyogi Uehara Animal Hospital Director Honda

As this was my first time welcoming a puppy, I was completely clueless, but the vet was incredibly kind and thorough in their response, which put my mind at ease. Their explanations were easy to understand, and they treated the puppy with such gentleness; I'm truly grateful. I would definitely like to continue using their services in the future. Thank you so much.

Thank you for your continued support.

The doctor and staff are all very kind, and the examinations are incredibly thorough.

They listen carefully to what we have to say and are very supportive of our anxieties.

My pet is able to relax during examinations, and it's a hospital we can bring to with peace of mind.

I truly believe this is the best animal hospital you can trust.
